# Stella - pinned, reproducible dependency set.
#
# Generated by scripts/sync_deps.ps1. This is the SOURCE OF TRUTH for the
# build environment - requirements*.txt describe intent, this file describes
# the exact versions that work.
#
# DO NOT hand-edit. Re-run sync_deps.ps1 -Freeze after changing anything.
#
# Why this exists: repeatedly running `pip install -r requirements.txt` on a
# metered connection re-resolves and re-downloads everything, which is
# expensive and produces a different tree each time. Pinning makes the venv
# reproducible and turns future installs into a small delta.
